dsh-llm-wiki.field.allowRawEdit: Allow agents to edit and delete their own raw notes
dsh-llm-wiki.field.mode: Mode: local (run here) or remote (run on the server over ssh)
dsh-llm-wiki.field.remoteCommand: Command to run on the server (leave empty when the key has a forced command)
dsh-llm-wiki.field.sshTarget: Server to use in remote mode (user@host or an ssh config alias)
dsh-llm-wiki.sshTarget.invalid: use only letters, digits and . _ @ : [ ] % - and do not start with a dash
dsh-llm-wiki.sshTarget.required: required when the mode is remote
